versos.grego: Τί οὖν τὸ περισσὸν τοῦ Ἰουδαίου, ἢ τίς ἡ ὠφέλεια τῆς περιτομῆς;

controles.web: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?
controles.kjv: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?
controles.livre: Qual, pois, é a vantagem do judeu? Ou qual é a utilidade da circuncisão?

versos.grego: πολὺ κατὰ πάντα τρόπον. πρῶτον μὲν γὰρ ὅτι ἐπιστεύθησαν τὰ λόγια τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the oracles of God.
controles.kjv: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.
controles.livre: Muita, em toda maneira. Pois, em primeiro lugar, as palavras de Deus lhes foram confiadas.

versos.grego: τί γάρ; εἰ ἠπίστησάν τινες, μὴ ἡ ἀπιστία αὐτῶν τὴν πίστιν τοῦ Θεοῦ καταργήσει;

controles.web: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?
controles.kjv: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?
controles.livre: Então, quê? Se alguns foram infiéis,  a infidelidade  deles anulará a fidelidade de Deus?

versos.grego: μὴ γένοιτο· γινέσθω δὲ ὁ Θεὸς ἀληθής, πᾶς δὲ ἄνθρωπος ψεύστης, καθάπερ γέγραπται Ὅπως ἂν δικαιωθῇς ἐν τοῖς λόγοις σου καὶ νικήσεις ἐν τῷ κρίνεσθαί σε.

controles.web: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written,  “That you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.”
controles.kjv: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.
controles.livre: De maneira nenhuma! Antes seja Deus verdadeiro, e todo ser humano mentiroso, como está escrito: “Para que sejas justificado em tuas palavras, e prevaleças quando julgares”.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ ἡ ἀδικία ἡμῶν Θεοῦ δικαιοσύνην συνίστησιν, τί ἐροῦμεν; μὴ ἄδικος ὁ Θεὸς ὁ ἐπιφέρων τὴν ὀργήν; κατὰ ἄνθρωπον λέγω.

controles.web: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.
controles.kjv: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)
controles.livre: E, se a nossa injustiça evidencia a justiça de Deus, que diremos? Acaso Deus é injusto em impor a sua ira? (Falo na lógica humana).

versos.grego: μὴ γένοιτο· ἐπεὶ πῶς κρινεῖ ὁ Θεὸς τὸν κόσμον;

controles.web: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?
controles.kjv: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?
controles.livre: De maneira nenhuma! De outro modo, como Deus julgará o mundo?

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ ἡ ἀλήθεια τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν τῷ ἐμῷ ψεύσματι ἐπερίσσευσεν εἰς τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ, τί ἔτι κἀγὼ ὡς ἁμαρτωλὸς κρίνομαι;

controles.web: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?
controles.kjv: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?
controles.livre: Mas se, através da minha mentira, a verdade de Deus foi mais abundante para a sua glória, por que ainda sou também julgado como pecador?

versos.grego: καὶ μὴ καθὼς βλασφημούμεθα καὶ καθώς φασίν τινες ἡμᾶς λέγειν ὅτι Ποιήσωμεν τὰ κακὰ ἵνα ἔλθῃ τὰ ἀγαθά; ὧν τὸ κρίμα ἔνδικόν ἐστιν.

controles.web: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let us do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.
controles.kjv: And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.
controles.livre: E por que não dizer : “Façamos o mal, para que venha o bem”, como alguns nos caluniam, afirmando que nós dizemos isto? (A condenação destes é justa).

versos.grego: Τί οὖν; προεχόμεθα; οὐ πάντως· προῃτιασάμεθα γὰρ Ἰουδαίους τε καὶ Ἕλληνας πάντας ὑφ’ ἁμαρτίαν εἶναι,

controles.web: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks, that they are all under sin.
controles.kjv: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;
controles.livre: Então, quê? Somos nós melhores? Não, de maneira nenhuma. Pois já delatamos que todos, tanto judeus como gregos, estão debaixo do pecado,

versos.grego: καθὼς γέγραπται ὅτι Οὐκ ἔστιν δίκαιος οὐδὲ εἷς,

controles.web: As it is written,  “There is no one righteous; no, not one.
controles.kjv: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:
controles.livre: como está escrito: Não há justo, nem um sequer.

versos.grego: οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ συνίων, οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ἐκζητῶν τὸν Θεόν·

controles.web: There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.
controles.kjv: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.
controles.livre: Ninguém há que entenda, ninguém há que busque a Deus.

versos.grego: πάντες ἐξέκλιναν, ἅμα ἠχρεώθησαν· οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ποιῶν χρηστότητα, οὐκ ἔστιν ἕως ἑνός.

controles.web: They have all turned aside. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.”
controles.kjv: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
controles.livre: Todos se desviaram, e juntamente se tornaram inúteis. “Não há quem faça o bem, não há um sequer”.

versos.grego: τάφος ἀνεῳγμένος ὁ λάρυγξ αὐτῶν, ταῖς γλώσσαις αὐτῶν ἐδολιοῦσαν, ἰὸς ἀσπίδων ὑπὸ τὰ χείλη αὐτῶν·

controles.web: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips”;
controles.kjv: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:
controles.livre: “Suas gargantas  são sepulcro aberto; com suas línguas enganam”;  “veneno de serpentes  está sob seus lábios”.

versos.grego: ὧν τὸ στόμα ἀρᾶς καὶ πικρίας γέμει·

controles.web: “whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”
controles.kjv: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:
controles.livre: “Suas bocas estão cheias de maldição e amargura”.

versos.grego: ὀξεῖς οἱ πόδες αὐτῶν ἐκχέαι αἷμα,

controles.web: “Their feet are swift to shed blood.
controles.kjv: Their feet are swift to shed blood:
controles.livre: “Seus pés são velozes para derramar sangue.

versos.grego: σύντριμμα καὶ ταλαιπωρία ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτῶν,

controles.web: Destruction and misery are in their ways.
controles.kjv: Destruction and misery are in their ways:
controles.livre: Destruição e miséria há em seus caminhos,

versos.grego: καὶ ὁδὸν εἰρήνης οὐκ ἔγνωσαν.

controles.web: The way of peace, they haven’t known.”
controles.kjv: And the way of peace have they not known:
controles.livre: e não conheceram o caminho da paz”.

versos.grego: οὐκ ἔστιν φόβος Θεοῦ ἀπέναντι τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῶν.

controles.web: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”
controles.kjv: There is no fear of God before their eyes.
controles.livre: “Diante dos seus olhos não há temor a Deus”.

versos.grego: Οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι ὅσα ὁ νόμος λέγει τοῖς ἐν τῷ νόμῳ λαλεῖ, ἵνα πᾶν στόμα φραγῇ καὶ ὑπόδικος γένηται πᾶς ὁ κόσμος τῷ Θεῷ·

controles.web: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.
controles.kjv: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.
controles.livre: Ora, sabemos que tudo o que a Lei diz, diz aos que estão na Lei, para que toda boca se cale, e todo o mundo seja condenável perante Deus.

versos.grego: διότι ἐξ ἔργων νόμου οὐ δικαιωθήσεται πᾶσα σὰρξ ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ· διὰ γὰρ νόμου ἐπίγνωσις ἁμαρτίας.

controles.web: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight. For through the law comes the knowledge of sin.
controles.kjv: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.
controles.livre: Assim, ninguém  será justificado diante dele pelas obras da Lei, porque o que vem pela Lei é o conhecimento do pecado.

versos.grego: Νυνὶ δὲ χωρὶς νόμου δικαιοσύνη Θεοῦ πεφανέρωται, μαρτυρουμένη ὑπὸ τοῦ νόμου καὶ τῶν προφητῶν,

controles.web: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;
controles.kjv: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;
controles.livre: Mas agora, independentemente da Lei, a justiça de Deus se manifestou, tendo testemunho da Lei e dos Profetas;

versos.grego: δικαιοσύνη δὲ Θεοῦ διὰ πίστεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, εἰς πάντας τοὺς πιστεύοντας· οὐ γάρ ἐστιν διαστολή·

controles.web: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,
controles.kjv: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:
controles.livre: isto é, a justiça de Deus por meio da fé em Jesus Cristo,  para todos os que creem; pois não há diferença;

versos.grego: πάντες γὰρ ἥμαρτον καὶ ὑστεροῦνται τῆς δόξης τοῦ Θεοῦ,

controles.web: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;
controles.kjv: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;
controles.livre: porque todos pecaram, e estão destituídos da glória de Deus;

versos.grego: δικαιούμενοι δωρεὰν τῇ αὐτοῦ χάριτι διὰ τῆς ἀπολυτρώσεως τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ·

controles.web: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus;
controles.kjv: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
controles.livre: e são justificados gratuitamente pela sua graça, por meio da redenção  que há em Cristo Jesus.

versos.grego: ὃν προέθετο ὁ Θεὸς ἱλαστήριον διὰ πίστεως ἐν τῷ αὐτοῦ αἵματι, εἰς ἔνδειξιν τῆς δικαιοσύνης αὐτοῦ διὰ τὴν πάρεσιν τῶν προγεγονότων ἁμαρτημάτων

controles.web: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice, through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;
controles.kjv: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
controles.livre: Deus propôs Jesus  por sacrifício de reconciliação, pela fé em seu sangue, para demonstrar a sua justiça. Ele deixou de considerar os pecados antes cometidos, sob a paciência de Deus,

versos.grego: ἐν τῇ ἀνοχῇ τοῦ Θεοῦ, πρὸς τὴν ἔνδειξιν τῆς δικαιοσύνης αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ νῦν καιρῷ, εἰς τὸ εἶναι αὐτὸν δίκαιον καὶ δικαιοῦντα τὸν ἐκ πίστεως Ἰησοῦ.

controles.web: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time; that he might himself be just, and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.
controles.kjv: To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.
controles.livre: para demonstrar a sua justiça neste presente tempo, a fim de que ele seja justo, e justificador daquele que tem fé em Jesus.

versos.grego: Ποῦ οὖν ἡ καύχησις; ἐξεκλείσθη. διὰ ποίου νόμου; τῶν ἔργων; οὐχί, ἀλλὰ διὰ νόμου πίστεως.

controles.web: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.
controles.kjv: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.
controles.livre: Onde, pois, está o orgulho? Este é excluído. Por qual lei? A das obras? Não, mas sim, pela Lei da fé.

versos.grego: λογιζόμεθα γὰρ δικαιοῦσθαι πίστει ἄνθρωπον χωρὶς ἔργων νόμου.

controles.web: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.
controles.kjv: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.
controles.livre: Concluímos, portanto, que o ser humano é justificado pela fé, independentemente das obras da Lei.

versos.grego: ἢ Ἰουδαίων ὁ Θεὸς μόνον; οὐχὶ καὶ ἐθνῶν; ναὶ καὶ ἐθνῶν,

controles.web: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,
controles.kjv: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:
controles.livre: Por acaso Deus é somente dos judeus, e não também dos gentios? Certamente que dos gentios também;

versos.grego: εἴπερ εἷς ὁ Θεός, ὃς δικαιώσει περιτομὴν ἐκ πίστεως καὶ ἀκροβυστίαν διὰ τῆς πίστεως.

controles.web: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith, and the uncircumcised through faith.
controles.kjv: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.
controles.livre: já que há um só Deus, que justificará pela fé os circuncisos, e por meio da fé os incircuncisos.

versos.grego: νόμον οὖν καταργοῦμεν διὰ τῆς πίστεως; μὴ γένοιτο, ἀλλὰ νόμον ἱστάνομεν.

controles.web: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.
controles.kjv: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.
controles.livre: Por acaso anulamos a Lei pela fé? De maneira nenhuma. Pelo contrário, confirmamos a Lei.
